name: The Cornerstone of Stars and Flames
descrition: The Cornerstone of Stars and Flames is a Character Level-Up Material. It is used exclusively with Traveler (Pyro) to level up their talents in place of Weekly Boss Drops. Unlike other characters that require 2 of the same Character Level-Up Materials to upgrade talent levels 9 and 10, Traveler (Pyro) only needs 1 The Cornerstone of Stars and Flames to upgrade.
